name: Detroit Automotive Technologies
old_description: Founded in 2003, Detroit Automotive Technologies (DAT) is an award-winning MBE supplier of interior trim and acoustic systems to automotive OEMs. DAT is a technology-driven organization and customers choose DAT because of the intense commitment to providing quality components and systems that exceed industry standards.
about:
Detroit Automotive Technologies (DAT) was founded in 2003 in Lansing, Michigan, as a minority-owned business enterprise (MBE). The company began as a supplier of interior trim and acoustic systems to automotive original equipment manufacturers.

DAT operates as a Tier 1 and Tier 2 manufacturer, producing interior trim and acoustic systems that are installed in over one million vehicles annually. The company describes itself as technology-driven, though specific manufacturing processes, facility size, and headcount are not disclosed.

The company serves major automotive OEMs directly and through tiered supply chains. Its customer base consists of vehicle manufacturers that integrate DAT components into production vehicles.

DAT states that its differentiation lies in an intense commitment to quality components and systems that exceed industry standards. Its mission emphasizes creating a comfortable, safe, and stylish driving experience through customer-focused, solution-driven innovation and teamwork.
